comment: shk.c dopay() 1945-1949: impossible("dopay: not to shopkeeper?"). Sell three wished darts in a general store and pick them up (unpaid). #wiztelekinesis hurtles the keeper out through the door: mhurtle() angers him through wakeup() but, unlike rloc_to_core()'s make_angry_shk(), never calls setpaid(), so the bill survives. The hero waits on the shop door until the angry keeper stands next to it outside the shop, then pays: the keeper is billing but is not the resident.
